metadata.research_subject: NVIDIA official product, platform, service, solution, and industry taxonomy
metadata.scope: Current public official NVIDIA index and portfolio pages reachable without authentication; normalized at named product-family/portfolio level.
metadata.not_in_scope: Partner entities, relationships, filings, individual NGC/build model artifacts, documentation leaf pages, regional store SKUs, accessories, discontinued products absent from current indexes, and an unbounded crawl of every nvidia.com URL.

node_type_definitions.product: Named sellable/deployable hardware or system family/SKU shown in an official portfolio.
node_type_definitions.service: Cloud-hosted, catalog, API, subscription, or managed access offering.
node_type_definitions.software: Named application, framework, library suite, driver, or infrastructure software.
node_type_definitions.sdk: Developer kit or application-specific framework primarily exposed as developer software.
node_type_definitions.solution: Use-case or workload-oriented NVIDIA solution page, not necessarily a separately sold SKU.
node_type_definitions.industry: Vertical-market solution entry from the current Industries index.
node_type_definitions.reference_architecture: Blueprint/design specification intended for partners or implementers rather than a single NVIDIA-built product.
node_type_definitions.architecture: Named compute/GPU platform generation or system architecture.
node_type_definitions.technology: Enabling technology that can appear across multiple products.
node_type_definitions.category: Navigation/normalization container; not itself a product conclusion.

metadata.completeness_basis: All names exposed by the current Products, Software, Solutions, and Industries index pages were processed; key portfolio pages were expanded to named families/items. Completeness is not claimed below the stated family/portfolio boundary.
